title: TRIAD-BANK: TRIAD-125 with O(n) classical workspace via a counted basis bank, T = O(n^132 2^((156/125) sqrt n))

claims.statement: For every N >= 2 and every s in Z/NZ, with n = ceil(log2 N), the single physical TRIAD-BANK algorithm and configuration specified in full in proof.md, which executes without change the reference algorithm P (TRIAD-125) whose complete specification and proof are reproduced in virtual.md (finite exhaustive branch for n < 2^28; otherwise r = ceil(sqrt n), ell = ceil(183r/500) recycling levels applying the exact three-qubit instrument TRIAD, with Kraus operators Pi_{000,111} and 2^(-1/2) Pi_{x_a != x_b} for the three pairs, to equal-key triples of a coherent qubit pool with sizes C_i = ceil(8 ell C_(i+1)/(3(ell-1))), a linear-merge collimation tree of depth m = ceil(73r/100) with leaf tables from dl = ceil(259r/500) pooled qubits, the free-frequency odd-part decoder and the controlled-shift 2-adic part), with every classical record of P except constant-many O(n)-bit staged words held in counted basis-state qubits that carry lazy generation tags of (n+2)^20 bits with exact renumbering, and with P's qubits held in a fixed counted array of quantum slots managed by an indexed free list, outputs the entire s with unconditional probability at least 1 - 2^-8 > 2/3 from independent ideal coset copies, and on EVERY execution branch, including wrong extracted labels, TRIAD-stage, supplier and pool aborts, failed and retried merges, discarded copies, tag renumbering, initialization and final cleanup, its total charged sequential work is T(N,s) = O(n^132 2^((156/125) sqrt n)) with an absolute constant, including all bank, tag, descriptor and slot operations, every source move, and the one-time preparation and output-first cleanup of the counted physical prefix (proof.md Sections 9-10: T <= c n^120 (T_P + Qcap + HQ + 1) + c n^100 DRAW for n >= n1 (the absolute threshold of proof.md Section 6), where T_P = O(n^6 2^((156/125) sqrt n)) is P's charged time and Qcap, HQ and DRAW are the source cap, slot count and RAW span defined in proof.md). The coefficient 156/125 is an explicit rational of P's integer schedule. The uniform bit-length envelope B_T(n) = n^132 2^((156/125) sqrt n) has growth index exactly 1/2. This holds jointly with the other three resource bounds and the tolerance claim for the same execution.

For every N >= 2 and every s in Z/NZ, with n = ceil(log2 N), the single physical TRIAD-BANK algorithm and configuration specified in full in proof.md, which executes without change the reference algorithm P (TRIAD-125) whose complete specification and proof are reproduced in virtual.md (finite exhaustive branch for n < 2^28; otherwise r = ceil(sqrt n), ell = ceil(183r/500) recycling levels applying the exact three-qubit instrument TRIAD, with Kraus operators Pi_{000,111} and 2^(-1/2) Pi_{x_a != x_b} for the three pairs, to equal-key triples of a coherent qubit pool with sizes C_i = ceil(8 ell C_(i+1)/(3(ell-1))), a linear-merge collimation tree of depth m = ceil(73r/100) with leaf tables from dl = ceil(259r/500) pooled qubits, the free-frequency odd-part decoder and the controlled-shift 2-adic part), with every classical record of P except constant-many O(n)-bit staged words held in counted basis-state qubits that carry lazy generation tags of (n+2)^20 bits with exact renumbering, and with P's qubits held in a fixed counted array of quantum slots managed by an indexed free list, outputs the entire s with unconditional probability at least 1 - 2^-8 > 2/3 from independent ideal coset copies, and on EVERY execution branch, including wrong extracted labels, TRIAD-stage, supplier and pool aborts, failed and retried merges, discarded copies, tag renumbering, initialization and final cleanup, its peak ordinary classical workspace is S_C(N,s) = O(n) bits with an absolute constant: the input and output, constant-many O(n)-bit staged words (addresses, indices, operands), O(1) staged bits, O(log n)-bit counters of bit-serial loops and the finite control. Every pool list, label table, sort and merge scratch array, decoder and label-extraction record, parameter profile, loop counter, recursion frame, quantum-slot descriptor and free-list field of the algorithm is held in the counted basis-state qubits, and epoch values are processed bit-serially, never staged. The envelope B_C(n) = n has growth index exactly 0. This holds jointly with the other three resource bounds and the tolerance claim for the same execution.

For every N >= 2 and every s in Z/NZ, with n = ceil(log2 N), the single physical TRIAD-BANK algorithm and configuration specified in full in proof.md, which executes without change the reference algorithm P (TRIAD-125) whose complete specification and proof are reproduced in virtual.md (finite exhaustive branch for n < 2^28; otherwise r = ceil(sqrt n), ell = ceil(183r/500) recycling levels applying the exact three-qubit instrument TRIAD, with Kraus operators Pi_{000,111} and 2^(-1/2) Pi_{x_a != x_b} for the three pairs, to equal-key triples of a coherent qubit pool with sizes C_i = ceil(8 ell C_(i+1)/(3(ell-1))), a linear-merge collimation tree of depth m = ceil(73r/100) with leaf tables from dl = ceil(259r/500) pooled qubits, the free-frequency odd-part decoder and the controlled-shift 2-adic part), with every classical record of P except constant-many O(n)-bit staged words held in counted basis-state qubits that carry lazy generation tags of (n+2)^20 bits with exact renumbering, and with P's qubits held in a fixed counted array of quantum slots managed by an indexed free list, outputs the entire s with unconditional probability at least 1 - 2^-8 > 2/3 from independent ideal coset copies, and on EVERY execution branch, including wrong extracted labels, TRIAD-stage, supplier and pool aborts, failed and retried merges, discarded copies, tag renumbering, initialization and final cleanup, its peak quantum workspace is S_Q(N,s) = O(n^30 2^((156/125) sqrt n)) qubits with an absolute constant. This counts the whole physical prefix of 2h wires, h the least power of two >= max(DRAW, HQ + 2), where U = C_0 + 2^(dl+m) + 1 with C_0 as in virtual.md, HQ = 2^20 n^2 U quantum slots, LSPAN = 2^56 n^8 U logical bits, EW = (n+2)^20 tag bits per logical bit and DRAW = LSPAN (EW+1) + (2^16 n^2 + 8) EW + 2^16 n^2 + 2^20 n^4 basis wires (values, tags, epochs, flags and scratch), together with one (n+1)-qubit acquisition register. Every free, unused, padding and metadata wire is counted, and the span is the same on every branch. The coefficient 156/125 is an explicit rational. The envelope B_Q(n) = n^30 2^((156/125) sqrt n) has growth index exactly 1/2. This holds jointly with the other three resource bounds and the tolerance claim for the same execution.

For every N >= 2 and every s in Z/NZ, with n = ceil(log2 N), the single physical TRIAD-BANK algorithm and configuration specified in full in proof.md, which executes without change the reference algorithm P (TRIAD-125) whose complete specification and proof are reproduced in virtual.md (finite exhaustive branch for n < 2^28; otherwise r = ceil(sqrt n), ell = ceil(183r/500) recycling levels applying the exact three-qubit instrument TRIAD, with Kraus operators Pi_{000,111} and 2^(-1/2) Pi_{x_a != x_b} for the three pairs, to equal-key triples of a coherent qubit pool with sizes C_i = ceil(8 ell C_(i+1)/(3(ell-1))), a linear-merge collimation tree of depth m = ceil(73r/100) with leaf tables from dl = ceil(259r/500) pooled qubits, the free-frequency odd-part decoder and the controlled-shift 2-adic part), with every classical record of P except constant-many O(n)-bit staged words held in counted basis-state qubits that carry lazy generation tags of (n+2)^20 bits with exact renumbering, and with P's qubits held in a fixed counted array of quantum slots managed by an indexed free list, outputs the entire s with unconditional probability at least 1 - 2^-8 > 2/3 from independent ideal coset copies, and on EVERY execution branch, including wrong extracted labels, TRIAD-stage, supplier and pool aborts, failed and retried merges, discarded copies, tag renumbering, initialization and final cleanup, the total number Q(N,s) of fresh DCP source copies acquired, including every rejected or discarded copy and every failed or aborted attempt, is Q(N,s) = O(n^3 2^((3307/2650) sqrt n)) with an absolute constant. There is exactly one acquisition per request of P, and P makes at most Qcap = 4 n C_0 + K requests, with C_0 and K defined in virtual.md; the finite branch uses at most N(n+10) copies. Bank, tag and slot bookkeeping and the SWAPs of acquired qubits into slots acquire no copies. The coefficient 3307/2650 is an explicit rational. The uniform bit-length envelope B_samples(n) = n^3 2^((3307/2650) sqrt n) has growth index exactly 1/2. This holds jointly with the other three resource bounds and the tolerance claim for the same execution.

For the same TRIAD-BANK algorithm and configuration of proof.md, the proved fractional error tolerance is epsilon(n) = 0: all Q acquired source copies are independent ideal coset states. Under this promise, for every N >= 2 and s, full-secret recovery succeeds with probability at least 1 - 2^-8 > 2/3 jointly with all four resource bounds. No positive corruption tolerance is asserted; this is not a proof that greater tolerance is impossible.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
